title: Source-owner pin verification error hides the real cause (deadline exceeded reported as 'no longer matches the pin')
outcome: When source-owner pin verification fails because its deadline expired (or for any reason other than a changed executable), the refusal message names the actual cause instead of always saying the executable no longer matches the pin.
acceptance: Source-owner pin verification error hides the real cause (deadline exceeded reported as 'no longer matches the pin') is done
